summary: Frontend-only regression + new-feature test on 390x844 mobile viewport. All new Chemicals-hub / list / low-stock / stock-adjust acceptance criteria PASS. (1) Hub renders exactly 6 tiles in the required order: Search Chemicals, My Chemicals, Chemical Inventory, Low Stock, Labels & SDS, Add Chemical (all testIDs chem-hub-search/my/inv/low/docs/add present). (2) Hub footer now reads the new 'Stock deducts automatically when spray jobs finish. Batches record lot number, purchase & expiry — with a 30-day nudge in the banner above.' text; the word 'roadmap' is gone. (3) All 6 tiles route correctly: Search → /chemicals, My → /chemicals, Chemical Inventory → /chemicals/inventory, Low Stock → /chemicals/low-stock, Labels & SDS (docs) → /chemicals/documents, Add Chemical → /chemicals/new. (4) Chemicals list rows show manufacturer BEFORE APVMA — verified 'Bayer · APVMA 62506 · Group M (Glycines)' on Roundup, plus 'Syngenta · APVMA 63151 · Group 1 (ACCase)' on Axial, 'Nufarm · APVMA 63536' on Estercide, 'FMC · APVMA 58207' on Talstar, 'Victorian Chemicals · APVMA 50387' on Hasten. (5) list-label icon (testID list-label-<id>) renders on Roundup (only seed chemical with label_url); tapping opens Linking.openURL without navigating into detail (Pressable has e.stopPropagation). No list-sds icons rendered — expected because no seed chemical has sds_url. (6) Category filter chips (All, Herbicide, Fungicide, Insecticide, Adjuvant, Fertiliser, Other) still render; archive toggle still present. (7) Chemical detail sections render in required order: name+type badge+AI+formulation, Identification (APVMA/group/manufacturer), Default rate, Inventory (pack size / current stock / storage), then Adjust Stock button (testID adjust-stock-btn), then Batches, then Documents, then Edit + Archive buttons. Recent stock movements card appears when movements exist. (8) Adjust Stock flow: Add/Remove toggle works, entering qty=2 shows green Preview card with '4 → 6 packs'; switching to Remove qty=99 flips card to red and displays '⚠ Stock will drop below zero.'; all 6 reason chips (Purchase, Correction, Spill, Transfer, Usage, Other) present. Saving Add 2 with reason Purchase persisted change (Current stock 4 → 6 packs) and recorded a StockMovement row on detail with '+2 packs · Purchase' + formatted timestamp. (9) Low Stock screen at /chemicals/low-stock lists only Axial (stock=1) — the only seeded chemical with stock ≤ 1 — with the green '+' quick-adjust shortcut (testID quick-adjust-<id>) that routes to stock-adjust. Sorted ascending. Empty-state, dedupe, search, archive toggle behaviours preserved. Spray-job auto-deduction rounding was already verified in iteration_6 (0.85 packs cleanly, not 0.8500…); the stock.applyDeductions Math.round×100/100 fix is present in /app/frontend/src/lib/stock.ts. No red-screen errors, no console errors observed. No deprecated Expo packages, no react-native issues detected in the reviewed files.
critical_code_review_comments: stock.ts recordManualMovement rounds delta before persisting — good; applyDeductions also rounds via Math.round × 100 / 100 — resolves the previous 0.8500000000000001 artifact.
chemicals/index.tsx list row correctly uses e.stopPropagation on the label/SDS quick-icons so tapping them opens the URL without navigating into detail.
low-stock.tsx uses '≤ 1' threshold matching the hub badge logic — consistent.
